projectBoundary: The public evidence applies only to the documented models, inputs, checks, and measured benchmark configuration. Real-device validation and manufacturing signoff are not claimed.

process.summary: The repository supports this documented workflow pattern. Individual examples exercise different subsets; no bundled case is a live production EDA-to-signoff flow.
process.boundary: This is the shared architecture across the checked examples and public contracts. No single bundled case executes every stage on a production design.

steps.title: Design and case inputs
steps.detail: Project-authored synthetic records or caller-supplied placement, power, PDN, and joint files

steps.title: Identity and provenance
steps.detail: Declared units and transforms with retained source-object, TSV, device, or joint IDs

steps.title: Analysis representation
steps.detail: Supported generated reference meshes or analytic and reduced representations

steps.title: Selected analysis
steps.detail: The documented electrical, thermal, mechanical, or stateful solder path

steps.title: Reviewable evidence
steps.detail: Named oracles, invariants, retained outputs, provenance, and claim boundaries

steps.title: Bounded feedback
steps.detail: Stable-ID screening quantities and back-annotation contracts, not live database edits

workflows.title: Axisymmetric TSV stress field
workflows.summary: Nine independent static CoupFE thermoelastic solves retain the 2,400-DOF radial mesh, displacement, radial stress, hoop stress, and residual telemetry at every prescribed load.
workflows.boundary: Axisymmetric plane-strain thermoelastic component verification against the declared Lamé equation. It is not a finite-depth 3-D TSV, near-surface device field, experimental validation, keep-out-zone signoff, or transient cooling simulation.

workflows.title: Partitioned ETV cycle
workflows.summary: Quasisteady and lumped-transient temperature assumptions drive the same spatial SAC305 mechanics calculation.
workflows.boundary: Uniform lagged thermal feedback; not a monolithic phi-T-u formulation, measured-device result, or predictive-life calculation.

workflows.title: Hex8 dissipation by layer
workflows.summary: Stateful 18-Hex8 SAC305 block exercising nonlinear assembly, equilibrium, and one state commit per accepted increment.
workflows.boundary: Idealized regular block at one mesh and load-step choice; not crack-location, mesh convergence, stabilized-cycle, or package-life evidence.

workflows.title: Design-linked solder screening
workflows.summary: A stable synthetic joint identity and distance-to-neutral-point value cross into the stateful 3-D block.
workflows.boundary: Only identity and L_D cross the handoff; geometry remains an idealized study input and the cycle count is calibration-specific, not predictive life.

workflows.title: TSV-to-device screening
workflows.summary: Synthetic device IDs pass through a Lamé far-field stress proxy, channel-oriented mobility proxies, and a deterministic orientation action.
workflows.boundary: Deterministic integration regression only; not experimental TSV validation.

scaling.title: Fixed-size distributed solve
scaling.boundary: A bounded local 1/2/4/8-rank measurement, not a general scalability or cross-machine performance claim.

tsvField.title: 30 µm TSV prescribed-cooling field
tsvField.claimBoundary: Axisymmetric plane-strain thermoelastic component verification against the declared Lamé equation. It is not a finite-depth 3-D TSV, near-surface device field, experimental validation, keep-out-zone signoff, or transient cooling simulation.
tsvField.videoInterpretation: Nine independent static CoupFE solves under prescribed uniform cooling, shown forward and backward without interpolation between solved load states; this is a load sweep, not a transient simulation.

simulationMedia.title: 3-D solder dissipation field
simulationMedia.alt: Two three-by-three heatmaps showing all 18 Hex8 accumulated inelastic-dissipation values across the two layers of the checked solder block
simulationMedia.summary: Every cell is one accepted Hex8 result from the checked SAC305 cycle; the fixed scale exposes the repeated center-column concentration without implying a crack prediction.
simulationMedia.detail: 18 elements · 8 accepted increments · two displayed layers
simulationMedia.boundary: Idealized regular block at one mesh and load-step choice; not crack-location, mesh-convergence, stabilized-cycle, or package-life evidence.

simulationMedia.title: ETV assumption comparison
simulationMedia.alt: Paired bars comparing quasisteady and lumped-transient inelastic energy and peak temperature for checked slow and fast ETV cycles
simulationMedia.summary: The same spatial SAC305 mechanics path is evaluated with quasisteady and backward-Euler lumped-temperature assumptions, separated into energy and temperature panels.
simulationMedia.detail: 1 s and 1,600 s periods · second-cycle values
simulationMedia.boundary: Uniform lagged thermal feedback; not a monolithic phi-T-u formulation, measured-device result, or predictive-life calculation.

simulationMedia.title: TSV-to-device identity map
simulationMedia.alt: Computed map of 32 synthetic device sites around a TSV comparing baseline channel orientations with a deterministic orientation-screening action
simulationMedia.summary: The runner carries 32 stable synthetic device identities through a Lamé far-field proxy and a deterministic channel-orientation action.
simulationMedia.boundary: Synthetic analytic integration regression; not a finite-element field, experimental TSV validation, transistor-delay prediction, or signoff keep-out zone.

tsvScreening.claimBoundary: Demonstrates identity-preserving stress-to-device mapping and a deterministic orientation action. It does not validate near-surface TSV stress, transistor delay, or a signoff keep-out zone.
tsvScreening.displayBoundary: This retained regression demonstrates identity-preserving stress-to-device mapping and a deterministic orientation-screening action for project-authored synthetic sites. It does not reproduce the near-surface 3-D TSV stress field, validate Raman or transistor measurements, predict delay, or establish a signoff keep-out zone.

stages.title: Reference case
stages.goal: Freeze permitted geometry or layout, materials, loads, stable identifiers, measurements, uncertainty, and immutable manifests.

stages.title: Numerical qualification
stages.goal: Complete experiment-matched boundary conditions, convergence and element comparisons, MPI qualification, conservation, and matched-fidelity studies.

stages.title: Experimental comparison
stages.goal: Compare global curvature and local Raman observables with declared alignment, uncertainty, tolerances, and held comparison data.

stages.title: Device mapping
stages.goal: Propagate an accepted 3-D field to device observables and reproduce the cited isolated-TSV and array cases.

stages.title: EDA design loop
stages.goal: Round-trip design identities and coordinates, back-annotate results, execute a legal design action, and report its penalties.

stages.title: Reproducible case release
stages.goal: Retain a locked environment, immutable inputs and results, release artifacts, checksums, and an external reproduction record.

categories.label: Numerical mechanics
categories.reason: near-surface Raman mesh/domain convergence, experiment-matched boundary conditions, an independent element comparison, and MPI MPC qualification remain open

categories.label: Multilevel accuracy
categories.reason: independent global/local meshes and a full-array reference are absent

categories.label: Conservation
categories.reason: force, moment, and virtual-work transfer checks are absent

categories.label: Matched-fidelity performance
categories.reason: the retained 526,338-DOF MPI rank sweep measures one distributed model; a matched-fidelity full-versus-reduced timing and memory comparison has not begun

categories.label: Global experiment
categories.reason: the comparison curves and uncertainty record are not bundled or reproduced

categories.label: Local experiment
categories.reason: the measured curves, masks, spatial-resolution record, and mesh/domain-qualified local field are incomplete

categories.label: Device mapping
categories.reason: published isolated and array contours have not been reproduced from an accepted 3-D field

categories.label: EDA semantics
categories.reason: no retained OpenDB/DEF round-trip case or coordinate round-trip check exists

categories.label: Design action
categories.reason: no legal-placement OpenDB action or design-penalty accounting is demonstrated

categories.label: Reproducibility
categories.reason: current-main CI and artifact guards pass, but a clean retained release-mode checkpoint and a lockfile-frozen Python/toolchain environment are still absent
